pages.text: Use the filter in your hand to open its editor. Add a sample, then select Allow List or Deny List.

pages.title: Advanced Filter
pages.text: Advanced filters can match stored NBT, such as a name or other item data.
An Extract filter applies before items leave the source. An Insert filter applies before they enter a destination. Click the configure button below an installed filter to edit it.

Set the sample count to the stock level you want. On Insert, a count of 16 stops filling once the attached inventory holds 16 matching items. On Extract, it leaves 16 behind. Only sampled items pass this filter.
